channel: measure computational basis and prepare the noncommuting full-rank states tau_0 and tau_1
theorem: For a computational-basis measure-and-prepare channel, optimizing recovery entanglement fidelity is exactly binary discrimination of tau_0 and tau_1 followed by basis-state preparation. Here Delta=tau_0-tau_1 has eigenvalues plus/minus 1/2. The rational Helstrom POVM gives discrimination sum 3/2, while Gamma=(tau_0+tau_1+|Delta|)/2 dominates both states and has trace 3/2. Therefore the global CPTP recovery optimum is (3/2)/4=3/8. The channel is nonunital, has Choi rank four, and prepares noncommuting states, so it is not unitarily equivalent to a Pauli mixture or to a qubit amplitude-damping channel.
